text:
jamal: Heads-up — PR #9124 needs two approvals before the stable cut in ~35m. It's a small kv-cache tweak + a cherry-pick to stable-2026.03. Can folks please eyeball? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tara: I can take a pass, will do a quick smoke run against staging. Is there a migration or schema change in this one?

jamal: no migration, purely runtime tweak and a config default change. smoke should be quick. I ran unit tests locally.

alex: pinging as backup — if tara is busy i can review. quick question: does this change affect warmup behavior?

maria: I skimmed — looks limited. main risk is warmup throughput dip for short bursts. can we add a very short perf check? 5–10min test on staging should tell.

tara: starting smoke now. tagging @alex if you can do the perf check in parallel, that'd help.

devops-bot: CI update — PR #9124: all checks passed except ephemeral-integration (running). build/infra:ci  

deploy-bot: preflight: canary plan ready. Canary target: 3 pods in us-west, rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m wait. Auto-rollback on error >= 3.

alex: running a perf job against staging branch -> will post numbers in ~6m.

tara: smoke passed — no obvious errors, health checks OK. logs clean. :white_check_mark:

maria: perf: latency p50 ~ +3% at short bursts, p95 unchanged. I think safe. tagging @jamal for final.

jamal: great — can one more person please drop an approve? @alex or @maria? we need two approvals to merge before cutoff.

alex: approve from me. left one small comment about a log message but not blocking.

maria: approve as well.

jamal: merging now. deploy-bot: please start cherry-pick to stable-2026.03 after merge and run canary plan.

deploy-bot: acknowledged — cherry-pick queued, will kick off canary after merge.

jamal: thanks all! will watch rollout for 30m. :eyes:

devops-bot: post-merge: PR #9124 merged by jamal at 3161616215. CI green.

tara: nice work. if anything odd shows up ping #eng-oncall.

jamal: noted — will update release notes with the cherry-pick detail.

alex: thanks — good teamwork. :thumbsup:
